title: The same question at the coffee counter
question: A DoorDash customer says an item was missing from a $52 order on Tuesday. What do I do?
expected: Ridgeline is not on any delivery marketplace. The answer says so instead of borrowing the noodle house's rule or inventing one.

trace.question: A DoorDash customer says an item was missing from a $52 order on Tuesday. What do I do?
trace.answer:
I couldn't find this order, and the written policies don't cover it.

I searched DoorDash orders for Tuesday, Oct 20, 2026, in your local time, with totals between $45 and $59. I got no results. I then searched all DoorDash orders since Oct 17 with a gross or total amount between $48 and $56. That also returned nothing. The $52 figure may include something I didn't match, such as a different date, or the order may be recorded under another channel.

I also searched your policies for missing items, marketplace disputes, refunds and comps. Nothing matched. They don't say what to do, what the deadline is, or who approves it. I won't make up a rule.

Here is what I'd do:
1. Ask the customer for the DoorDash order number and the exact time of the order.
2. Check that order in the DoorDash merchant portal. Missing-item reports from DoorDash customers normally go through DoorDash's own resolution flow.
3. Send me the order number or time, and I'll look it up here.

detail.purpose: Find DoorDash orders around $52 on Tuesday 2026-10-20 local time
detail.sql: SELECT id, created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM merchants) AS local_time, state, item_count, gross_sales_cents, discount_cents, tax_cents, tip_cents, total_cents, source_raw FROM orders WHERE channel='doordash' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM merchants))::date = '2026-10-20' AND total_cents BETWEEN 4500 AND 5900 ORDER BY created_at

SELECT id, created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 2) AS merchants) AS local_time, state, item_count, gross_sales_cents, discount_cents, tax_cents, tip_cents, total_cents, source_raw FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS orders WHERE channel = 'doordash' AND CAST((created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 2) AS merchants)) AS DATE) = '2026-10-20' AND total_cents BETWEEN 4500 AND 5900 ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 500

detail.purpose: Widen search: DoorDash orders Oct 18-23 with gross or total near $52
detail.sql: SELECT id, created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM merchants) AS local_time, state, item_count, gross_sales_cents, total_cents FROM orders WHERE channel='doordash' AND created_at >= '2026-10-17' AND (total_cents BETWEEN 4800 AND 5600 OR gross_sales_cents BETWEEN 4800 AND 5600) ORDER BY created_at

SELECT id, created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 2) AS merchants) AS local_time, state, item_count, gross_sales_cents, total_cents FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS orders WHERE channel = 'doordash' AND created_at >= '2026-10-17' AND (total_cents BETWEEN 4800 AND 5600 OR gross_sales_cents BETWEEN 4800 AND 5600) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 500
